description:
Three seismic stations in the GEOFON network currently have no module bindings configured, meaning their waveform data is not being processed by any SeisComP analysis module. The network operations team has decided that all three stations — GE.GSI (Geostationary), GE.BKB, and GE.SANI — must be configured for automatic phase detection and amplitude computation.

In scconfig, open the Bindings panel (the tab showing the station inventory tree on the left and module bindings on the right). For each of the three stations (GE.GSI, GE.BKB, GE.SANI), add both of the following module bindings:
1. `scautopick` — using the `default` profile (for automatic P/S phase detection)
2. `scamp` — using the `default` profile (for amplitude measurement, required for magnitude computation)

After configuring all six bindings (two modules × three stations), save the configuration using the Save button and then click Update to write the key files. The bindings must be reflected in the station key files at `/home/ga/seiscomp/etc/key/station_GE_GSI`, `station_GE_BKB`, and `station_GE_SANI`.
